verdict.rationale: gstack lets agents author skills in narrow forms. The /skillify meta-skill codifies a /scrape intent into a reusable script, and domain-skills let the agent save per-site notes it writes for itself and promote them from project to global scope. Contributors can also develop skills in place via dev mode's symlink into .claude/skills. However, the evidence shows no general spec, template, or meta-skill for authoring and packaging an arbitrary new gstack skill end to end. Missing for 10: a documented general skill-authoring spec or template, a packaging and distribution workflow for new SKILL.md skills, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
